digest.component_or_area: opcert service app lifespan and worker
propositions: Python 3.11 asyncio.wait_for consumes external worker cancellation when child future completes in same turn, leaving worker with pending cancellation count
opcert worker loops back to queue.get() with cancelling()==1 while lifespan awaits task forever, causing TestClient teardown hang and xdist timeout
Replacing asyncio.wait_for with asyncio.timeout semantics in app.py:76-83 preserves cancellation and retains per-job timeout while fixing the race
Regression oracle test_worker_cancellation_survives_job_completion_race observed RED on Python 3.11 before fix and GREEN after fix with exact defect mutation validation
Original lone-test and xdist scenarios no longer hang on Python 3.11; opcert suite remains green on Python 3.12+ with all existing semantics preserved
